source_text: This superhero narrative frames neonatal circumcision, performed on approximately 1.2 million U.S. infants annually as of 2010 data, as a battle against evil forces, potentially fostering fear-mongering by equating a brief surgical intervention with violent assault rather than a decision weighed against evidence of benefits like reduced urinary tract infections (1-2% risk reduction in infancy) and certain STIs.
